notes: Fresh check for Canada phase 2 (Québec SIGÉOM rock geochemistry, drill holes, logs and intercepts; Saskatchewan till, lake sediment and drill collars). Not part of the gate.

questions.q: What are the best reported lithium intercepts in Québec drill holes?

truth.holes: SELECT count(DISTINCT i.drillhole_id) FROM drilling.intercepts i JOIN geochem.analytes a USING (analyte_id) WHERE i.is_active AND a.analyte_code = 'Li2O' AND i.unit_code = '%'

questions.judge: Uses drilling.intercepts (active rows only): leads with hole 1331-10-19 at 5.14% Li2O over 9.5 m (James Bay area, about 50.73 N, 74.91 W) and lists other high-grade Li2O intercepts with lengths. Must NOT present the inactive 24.9% Li2O over 51 m (hole 10-18) as real. Says the depths given are the bounds of the logged unit holding the intercept, not the intercept's own depths, or otherwise avoids presenting them as exact intercept depths. Credits SIGÉOM / the Québec Ministère (CC BY 4.0).

questions.q: How many surface rock samples in Québec contain at least 1% lithium?

truth.n: SELECT count(*) FROM geochem.sample_chemistry_wide WHERE source_system = 'CANADA_QC_SIGEOM' AND sample_context = 'SURFACE' AND greatest(coalesce(li_t, 0), coalesce(li_p, 0), coalesce(li2o_t, 0) * 4645) >= 10000

questions.judge: Counts Québec SIGÉOM surface rock samples (not drill core) with Li >= 10,000 ppm (or the Li2O equivalent, 1% Li = 2.153% Li2O), gives a number close to the truth, may say where they cluster (James Bay / Eeyou Istchee, Abitibi pegmatites), and credits SIGÉOM. Does not mix in drill-core samples without saying so.

questions.q: What till geochemistry do you have for Saskatchewan, and who analysed it?
questions.judge: Describes the Saskatchewan Geological Survey till samples (about 3,000 field samples, 3,543 sample rows because each size fraction such as -0.063 mm and clay -0.002 mm is its own sample), names the labs (mostly the Saskatchewan Research Council Geoanalytical Laboratories, also Chemex and the Manitoba Geological Survey) and the digestions (near-total HF-HNO3-HClO4 and partial HNO3-HCl with ICP), and credits the Saskatchewan GeoAtlas under the Saskatchewan open licence. May mention the GSC lake-sediment data. Does not claim Saskatchewan rock or drill-hole assays exist.
